from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta


def test_relativedelta_weeks__positive_exact_multiple():
    rd = relativedelta(days=14)
    assert rd.weeks == 2


def test_relativedelta_weeks__positive_non_multiple():
    rd = relativedelta(days=10)
    assert rd.weeks == 1


def test_relativedelta_weeks__zero_days():
    rd = relativedelta(days=0)
    assert rd.weeks == 0


def test_relativedelta_weeks__negative_non_multiple():
    rd = relativedelta(days=-10)
    assert rd.weeks == -1


def test_relativedelta_weeks__fractional_days():
    rd = relativedelta(days=7.5)
    assert rd.weeks == 1


def _assert_fields(rd, *, years=0, months=0, days=0, hours=0, minutes=0,
                  seconds=0, microseconds=0, leapdays=0,
                  year=None, month=None, day=None, weekday=None,
                  hour=None, minute=None, second=None, microsecond=None):
    """Helper to compare the public attributes of a relativedelta."""
    assert rd.years == years
    assert rd.months == months
    assert rd.days == days
    assert rd.hours == hours
    assert rd.minutes == minutes
    assert rd.seconds == seconds
    assert rd.microseconds == microseconds
    assert rd.leapdays == leapdays
    assert rd.year == year
    assert rd.month == month
    assert rd.day == day
    assert rd.weekday == weekday
    assert rd.hour == hour
    assert rd.minute == minute
    assert rd.second == second
    assert rd.microsecond == microsecond


def test_relativedelta_normalized__fractional_hours_cascade_to_minutes():
    rd = relativedelta(hours=1.5)
    norm = rd.normalized()
    # 0.5 hour = 30 minutes, hours truncated to 1
    assert norm.hours == 1
    assert norm.minutes == 30


def test_relativedelta_normalized__fractional_minutes_cascade_to_seconds():
    rd = relativedelta(minutes=1.5)
    norm = rd.normalized()
    # 0.5 minute = 30 seconds, minutes truncated to 1
    _assert_fields(norm, minutes=1, seconds=30)
    # Ensure the test itself contains an assertion (not only via helper)
    assert norm.minutes == 1
    assert norm.seconds == 30


def test_relativedelta_normalized__fractional_seconds_cascade_to_microsecon():
    rd = relativedelta(seconds=1.5)
    norm = rd.normalized()
    assert norm.seconds == 1
    assert norm.microseconds == 500_000


def test_relativedelta_normalized__fractional_days_cascade_to_hours():
    rd = relativedelta(days=1.5, hours=2)
    norm = rd.normalized()
    # 0.5 day = 12 hours, added to 2 => 14 hours, days truncated to 1
    assert norm.days == 1
    assert norm.hours == 14


def test_relativedelta_normalized__multiple_cascades_and_overflow():
    """
    Fractional parts should cascade down and overflow should be fixed.
    Input: days=1.5, hours=25.5, minutes=61.5
    Expected after normalization:
        days=2, hours=14, minutes=31, seconds=30, microseconds=0
    """
    rd = relativedelta(days=1.5, hours=25.5, minutes=61.5)
    norm = rd.normalized()
    # Check each field individually with literal expectations
    assert norm.years == 0
    assert norm.months == 0
    assert norm.days == 2
    assert norm.hours == 14
    assert norm.minutes == 31
    assert norm.seconds == 30
    assert norm.microseconds == 0


def test_relativedelta_normalized__already_normalized():
    # Input relativedelta already uses integer values for days and hours
    rd = relativedelta(days=2, hours=3)

    # Normalizing should produce an equivalent object with the same integer fields
    norm = rd.normalized()

    # Core relative fields
    assert norm.years == 0
    assert norm.months == 0
    assert norm.days == 2
    assert norm.hours == 3
    assert norm.minutes == 0
    assert norm.seconds == 0
    assert norm.microseconds == 0
    assert norm.leapdays == 0

    # Absolute fields (should remain None because they were not supplied)
    assert norm.year is None
    assert norm.month is None
    assert norm.day is None
    assert norm.weekday is None
    assert norm.hour is None
    assert norm.minute is None
    assert norm.second is None
    assert norm.microsecond is None
